---
title: "NWA KelpTime Site Map Before Filtering"
html:
  page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(root.dir = here::here(), message = FALSE, warning = FALSE) 
setwd(here::here())

library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(glue)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

nwa_dat <- read_csv("data/kelptime_nwa_all_data.csv") |>
  mutate(trajectory = paste(study, site))

good_cols <- colors() |> 
  stringr::str_subset("gr[ea]y", negate = TRUE) |>
  stringr::str_subset("black", negate = TRUE) |>
  gplots::col2hex()

# make sf obj
nwa_dat <- nwa_dat |> st_as_sf(
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)

# get site-level LL
nwa_grouped <- nwa_dat |>
  group_by(trajectory) |>
  summarize(study = study[1],
            site = site[1],
            min_year = min(sample_year),
            max_year = max(sample_year),
            n = n(),
            eco_collapsed = ecoregion[1]) |>
  mutate(text = glue("{trajectory}<br>study: {study}<br>{min_year} - {max_year}, n = {n}<br>site: {site}<br>{eco_collapsed}"),
         col = good_cols[rank(trajectory) |> round()])

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = nwa_grouped |> st_centroid(),
             fillColor = ~col,
             fillOpacity = 0.8,
             popup = ~text,
             stroke = 0)

```
